cases.text: Hooks are no longer read from `~/.claude/settings.json`.
Hooks are now read only from `~/.claude/hooks.json`.
Hooks are read only from `~/.claude/hooks.json` or `~/.claude/settings.json`.
Project hooks are no longer read from `.claude/settings.json`.
In cloud sessions, hooks are no longer read from `~/.claude/settings.json`.
If hooks are no longer read from `~/.claude/settings.json`, migrate the configuration.
The `hooks` registration key is no longer accepted.
`command` hook handler type is no longer accepted.
It is not true that hooks are no longer read from `~/.claude/settings.json`.
The `otherHooks` registration key is no longer accepted.
The `PreToolUse` hook event has been removed.
Added `FutureEvent` hook event.
Added `DirectoryAdded` hook event.

`PreToolUse` hook `tool_input` field is now a string.
`PreToolUse` hook `tool_input` field has type object.

`PreToolUse` hook `model` field is no longer provided.
`PreToolUse` hook `tool_use_id` field is no longer sent.
`PreToolUse` hooks now ignore `permissionDecision: "deny"`.
`Elicitation` hooks now ignore `decision: "block"`.
`Elicitation` hooks now ignore `action: "decline"`.
`updatedInput` from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks is now validated against each tool's schema.
`PreToolUse` hook now runs after the tool call executes.
`PreToolUse` hook now runs asynchronously.
`PreToolUse` hook hard timeout is now 5 seconds.
`PreToolUse` hook default timeout is now 5 seconds.
`PreToolUse` hook exit code 2 no longer blocks the tool call.
`PreToolUse` hook exit code 3 no longer blocks the tool call.
